== Usage ==
The '''Tactical Insertion'''{{'}}s {{AN|Gorilla Tactics}} ability marks the player's locations, teleporting them to the marked location after {{Green|3s}}. Upon teleporting, the '''Tactical Insertion''' {{Gold|burns}} nearby enemies within {{Green|3}} blocks and sets the player's {{Stat|hp}} to half of what it was prior to teleporting. The {{Gold|burn}} deals {{Red|10%}} of all damage dealt in the last {{Green|3s}}, spreading out over a {{Green|6s}} period. The ability costs {{Stat|mana|200}} and has a {{Green|20s}} cooldown.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Tactical Insertion''' can deal full damage to all mobs, regardless of any damage reduction.
** This means it can one shot a {{SlayerTier|II}}+ {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}}, regardless of whether their {{AN|Hellion Shield}} is active.
*The ability name {{AN|Gorilla Tactics}} is a play on the term ''Guerrilla warfare'', which refers to a situation when a small non-military group faces typically larger military forces.
